label: D1 after reward, with a moderate a2 preference
explanation: Fires only at D1, only when the reward input is 1, and essentially only when the agent goes on to choose a2. The upcoming choice is the agent own, and the previous choice is also a2 in about 82% of the activation mass, since it stays almost every time. Within that set it is selective. Its D1 policy logit (choice) always sits in a moderate a2-favouring band, (-4.44, -1.52), and its value output is mid-high, (7.13, 7.73). The recorded predicate uses only observed quantities: D1 + rewarded + choice band + value band (dev F1 0.60, mass recall 0.92). The simpler D1 & in_rew==1 & action==2 has recall 0.999 but precision only 0.26, and adding the choice band alone gives F1 0.47 with recall 1.0. Rate also depends on episode position: it peaks at trials 20-60, is near zero before trial 10 and at 90-99, and is higher when S2 is good. It never fires at GO or D2, after an unrewarded trial, or before an a1 choice. The missed false positives look like the same contexts, so the remaining selectivity is probably a slow drift in hidden state across the episode rather than a task variable.
